theorem_title: Size and dynamic multiplier sum of the 8-row YAH symbol certificate
natural_language_statement:
Let $C_s$ be the fixed labeled YAH symbol certificate, whose entries $(a,r)$ consist of a natural multiplier $a$ and a row $r$. A row is dynamic exactly when its rule is $D_f$ or $D_t$. Then

$$|C_s|=8\quad\text{and}\quad\sum_{(a,r)\in C_s\,:\,r\text{ dynamic}}a=5.$$

The second number is the sum of multipliers on dynamic rows, not the number of such rows. This records the finite certificate data independently of its cancellation consequence.
preamble:

formal_statement:
theorem CollatzWork.YAH.symbolCertificate_shape :
    symbolCertificate.length = 8 ∧
    (symbolCertificate.filter fun entry => (rule entry.2.ruleName).dynamic).foldr
      (fun entry total => entry.1 + total) 0 = 5 := by sorry
